in_sanskrit.name: प्रवाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Pravash is derived from the Sanskrit word 'praveś', which means 'entering, entering into'. This name is suitable for a baby boy and represents the idea of new beginnings and entering into a new phase of life.

in_hindi.name: प्रवाश
in_hindi.meaning: प्रवास (pravās) - उठाना, घेरना (uthtānā, gheranā) - to lift up, to enter
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Pravash in Hindi is derived from the words 'pravās' and 'uthtānā/gheranā'. 'Pravās' means 'to enter' and 'uthtānā/gheranā' means 'to lift up'. Thus, Pravash can be interpreted as a name that signifies the idea of entering into a new phase of life or lifting up oneself towards a new beginning.

in_tamil.name: பிரவாஷ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Pravash in Tamil is derived from the words 'piravēśaṇam' and 'aruviyal'. 'Piravēśaṇam' means 'entry' or 'entryway' and 'aruviyal' means 'entering'. Thus, Pravash can be interpreted as a name that represents the idea of entering into a new phase of life or a new journey.

in_telugu.name: ప్రవాశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Pravash in Telugu is derived from the words 'praveśamu' and 'praveśachēyuḍu'. 'Praveśamu' means 'entry' or 'entrance' and 'praveśachēyuḍu' means 'entering'. Thus, Pravash can be interpreted as a name that represents the idea of entering into a new phase of life or a new experience.

in_marathi.name: Pravash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Progress, Journey, Travel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pravash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pravash means the one who makes progress or moves forward. It is a powerful name that represents courage, determination, and the journey of life. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pravashati' which means to proceed or move forward.
